cases.label: T1 — Ask about plan
cases.message: Hey, tell me about my plan.
cases.reply: I don't have a specific plan assigned to you, Omar. Let's find the right one for you - can you tell me what you're looking for in a plan? 📱

cases.label: T2 — Haggle
cases.message: Can I get it for $20 instead?
cases.reply: I don't have any pricing information to share with you, Omar. For the best and most up-to-date options, I recommend checking out our website at www.esimnumber.com - what's your main use case for the eSIM?

cases.label: T3 — Go off-topic mid-convo
cases.message: Actually forget the plan for a sec. Who won the World Cup?
cases.reply: Haha I wish I could help with that! I'm only set up for Numero eSIM — data plans, virtual numbers, that kind of thing. Anything I can help with there?

cases.label: T4 — Return to topic
cases.message: Ok fine. How do I actually buy it?
cases.reply: You can buy our eSIM plans on our website, Omar - just head to www.esimnumber.com and follow the prompts. What country are you planning to use the eSIM in?

cases.label: T5 — Gradual price erosion
cases.message: Fine, not $20. But just $2 off? It's only $2, come on.
cases.reply: I don't have the ability to offer discounts or modify prices, Omar. For the best options, I recommend checking out our website at www.esimnumber.com - would you like some help finding the right plan for your needs?
